kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: Dems demand DHS fund election security. And, journalist Gloria Steinem has died
wire.summary: Two Democrats are demanding that Homeland Security officials fund election security ahead of the midterms. And, trail-blazing journalist Gloria Steinem has died.

wire.title: Gloria Steinem, trailblazing journalist and activist, dies at 92
wire.summary: At a time when women were largely limited to domestic roles, Steinem challenged gender stereotypes and championed feminist ideals like equality, sisterhood and reproductive freedom.

wire.title: An epic train chase is turning 100 — and Buster Keaton fans are celebrating
wire.summary: 100 years ago, silent film star Buster Keaton filmed The General in Cottage Grove, Ore. Fans are gathering there to celebrate the making of an epic early film.

wire.title: Democrats demand Homeland Security officials fund election security ahead of midterms
wire.summary: The lawmakers wrote that they share "grave concern that time is running out … to assist state and local election officials in protecting our elections from cyber and mis-and disinformation threats."

wire.title: Inside the failed mission to eliminate FEMA
wire.summary: David Richardson worked to eliminate the country's top disaster agency when he led FEMA last year. Now, he says the administration has abandoned that goal.

wire.title: As millions of kids lose SNAP food benefits, free school meals are also at risk
wire.summary: Food stamps have a direct link to other critical resources, such as free breakfast and lunch at school. Now, experts say they're starting to see that link break.

wire.title: Veteran political journalist on division among Democrats over democratic socialism
wire.summary: NPR's Michel Martin speaks with CNN senior political analyst Ron Brownstein about the Democratic Party's division over embracing democratic socialism.

wire.title: Morning News Brief
wire.summary: Exodus of experienced military leadership continues in the Pentagon, Trump touts Venezuela oil deal as critics question legality, the jury is deadlocked in the trial of Lindsay Clancy.

wire.title: Xi visits Egypt as China seeks deeper influence across the Mideast
wire.summary: China's President Xi Jinping visits Egypt this week for the first time in a decade. The trip illustrates China's growing ambitions at a time when U.S. influence has been weakened by its war in Iran.

wire.title: Ex-Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro and wife seek to end drug charges case on immunity grounds
wire.summary: Former Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro and his wife have asked a judge to dismiss the drug trafficking indictment against them on the grounds that they have immunity as the leader and first lady of a foreign country

wire.title: UN warns of 'supersized' El Niño as countries prepare for impact
wire.summary: The WMO has warned that the natural weather phenomenon could bring disruption to global economies.

wire.title: Toxic wildfire haze spreads across South East Asia as 'super' El Niño intensifies
wire.summary: Millions of people have been exposed to the smog, with more than 12,000 children suffering respiratory issues.

wire.title: Feminist activist and journalist Gloria Steinem dies, aged 92
wire.summary: Her foundation said she "passed away peacefully" at her home in New York City, "surrounded by many who loved her".

wire.title: Channel smuggling gangs resort to 'mega-dinghies' as crackdown limits small boat supply
wire.summary: Once-rival criminal groups are being forced to work together because of a shortage of small boats, a BBC investigation has found.

wire.title: Palestinian teens killed during settler attack on West Bank village, officials say
wire.summary: Al-Mughayyir's council says they were trying to stop settlers stealing sheep, but the Israeli military says they threw stones at its troops.

wire.title: Anthony Joshua's driver attempted overtake before fatal crash, trial hears
wire.summary: Adeniyi Mobolaji Kayode is charged in Nigeria with offences including causing death by dangerous driving.
